# Clashworks

> Clashworks is Clayton Trevino's AI operations business in Dallas, Texas. He fixes how local service businesses and property or rental operators get and answer leads (websites, quote forms, a text that goes out on its own when you miss a call, reviews, booking sync, AI search visibility) and documents every fix in public. Clayton is a Finance and Real Estate major at SMU's Cox School of Business. Every paid fix ships with tracking and a Measured-or-Free guarantee: one number agreed up front, measured 30 days after delivery, full refund of fees if it cannot be shown. No promises on rankings or lead counts.

## Start here

- [Home](https://clashworks.co/): who it is for, the services, how pricing and the guarantee work, and the FAQ
- [Free video review](https://clashworks.co/check.html): apply for a free 10-minute video review of a website, Google listing, and how the business runs; two a week, reply within seven days
- [Services and prices](https://clashworks.co/services.html): the full list of 13 offers in plain words, each with a starting price
- [Who I am](https://clashworks.co/about.html): Clayton Trevino's background, how he works, and what he has built
- [The stack](https://clashworks.co/stack.html): the AI tools and setup behind the work, as shown in reel 01

## Services

- Fix: One Quick Fix (one tool set up with a counter), Never Miss a Customer (quote form, automatic missed-call text, review requests, end to end), Get Found on Google (Maps listing, reviews, service pages, monthly check of Google and ChatGPT)
- Build: One-Page Website, New Website, One Chore, Gone, Rental Owner Reports for rental operators, A Custom Tool for Your Team
- Market: Written Game Plan, AI Search Check-in (a monthly check of whether ChatGPT and Google suggest you)
- Run: Front Desk Training, Website Upkeep, Monthly Upkeep
- Every job is fixed-price, quoted from the free video review

## Policies

- [Terms](https://clashworks.co/terms.html): the guarantee's full conditions, not legal or financial advice, results and reviews, AI-made content
- [Privacy policy](https://clashworks.co/privacy.html): what the forms collect, no cookies of its own, no trackers, nothing sold
- [Accessibility](https://clashworks.co/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.2 AA target, how it was tested, how to report a problem
